name: GitHub Copilot CLI (copilot)
description: GitHub Copilot CLI (https://docs.github.com/copilot/concepts/agents/about-copilot-cli) as a member of this collection's ecosystem, and the second vendor for the participant component's contracts: brings the CLI in through dependsOn on the official ghcr.io/devcontainers/features/copilot-cli (which installs it, pinned to Copilot CLI 1.0.114; this Feature installs no binary of its own) and adds agent-adapter-copilot (new, resume, run-once for the facilitator's pump, mcp-attach, and from 0.3.0 skills and skills-show: the component registry's rendered skills into $COPILOT_HOME/skills and, for what one agent alone resolves, a folder its sessions read through --add-dir; exit 3 for the verbs Copilot has no local route for), the participants option (the participant component, one shared copy with claude-code), the attach option (attach: facilitator registers the facilitator's MCP entry through `copilot mcp add`, with no token in it), COPILOT_HOME as a named volume so a copilot login survives rebuilds, and a post-create hook (copilot-setup) that makes it usable and private. Never logs in and never stores a token. Plus the Feature Taskfile.

installTaskfile.description: Also install this Feature's Taskfile into /usr/local/share/go-task/includes.d so its tasks appear under the <id>: namespace of a root Taskfile that includes /usr/local/share/go-task/features.yml (see the go-task Feature).

participants.description: Install the participant component: the agent list (.devcontainer/participants.yml or PARTICIPANTS_FILE; agents.yml and AGENTS_FILE still work), the agents command and the agents:* tasks, which call agent-adapter-copilot for an entry with cli: copilot. One copy in /usr/local/lib/dcf-participant, shared with claude-code and the deprecated agents Feature, whichever installs it (the newest wins). Copilot has no local background mode, so a copilot participant is on-demand or ephemeral, never resident.

attach.description: 'facilitator': at post-create (and by task copilot:attach) register the facilitator's MCP entry through Copilot's own command (copilot mcp add facilitator ...), so a Copilot session can use receive, reply, say and who. The entry carries no token: the harness starts copilot with FACILITATOR_HANDLE and FACILITATOR_TOKEN in its environment. Does nothing, and says so, while the facilitator Feature is not installed. Empty: nothing is registered. Other values are reserved and fail the build.
